unit_description: This unit places fractions on number lines. Students understand the interval from 0 to 1, partition number lines into equal lengths, locate unit fractions, and graph non-unit fractions.
unit_goals: Understand the interval from 0 to 1 on a number line.
Partition number lines into equal lengths.
Locate unit fractions on number lines.
Connect fraction models to number lines.

weeks.weekly_focus: Students learn to partition the interval from 0 to 1 and locate unit and non-unit fractions on a number line.

lessons.fact_drill: Warm up by locating 0, 1, and 1/2 on a number line.
lessons.concept: On a fraction number line, 0 is the start and 1 is the end of the whole. Fractions between 0 and 1 show parts of the whole.
lessons.practice: Label 0, 1, and fractions between 0 and 1 on a number line.
lessons.objective: Understand the interval from 0 to 1 on a number line.

questions.prompt: On a fraction number line, where is the whole?
Where does a fraction number line start?
Are fractions less than 1 between 0 and 1?
questions.hint: Fractions of a whole are between 0 and 1.

learn.title: Understand the Interval from 0 to 1
teaching_points: 0 is the start and 1 is the end of one whole.
Fractions less than 1 are between 0 and 1.
The distance from 0 to 1 is one whole.

example.prompt: Label 1/2 on a number line from 0 to 1.

try_it.title: Try one together
try_it.prompt: Show where 1/4 would be on a number line from 0 to 1.
try_it.hint: Divide 0 to 1 into 4 equal parts and go 1 part.

practice_block.title: Practice Time
practice_block.instructions: Label each point on a 0 to 1 number line.

bigIdea.title: Understand the Interval from 0 to 1
bigIdea.subtitle: Fractions live between 0 and 1
bigIdea.intro: A fraction number line shows how the space from 0 to 1 is divided. The whole is at 1, and fractions are the points in between.

ruleCards.description: Number lines for fractions start at 0.
The distance from 0 to 1 is one whole.

lessons.lesson_title: Partition Number Lines into Equal Lengths
lessons.fact_drill: Warm up by dividing a number line from 0 to 1 into 2, 3, and 4 equal parts.
lessons.concept: To show fractions on a number line, divide the space from 0 to 1 into equal parts. The number of parts is the denominator. For fourths, make 4 equal spaces.
lessons.practice: Partition number lines from 0 to 1 into equal lengths.
lessons.objective: Partition number lines into equal lengths.

questions.prompt: How many equal parts are needed to show thirds on a number line?
To show fourths, how many tick marks are between 0 and 1?
How many equal spaces are needed to show sixths?

learn.title: Partition Number Lines into Equal Lengths
teaching_points: Divide 0 to 1 into the denominator number of parts.
Each part is the same length.
The number of spaces equals the denominator.

example.prompt: Partition a number line from 0 to 1 into 4 equal parts.

try_it.title: Try one together
try_it.prompt: Partition a number line from 0 to 1 into 3 equal parts.

practice_block.title: Practice Time
practice_block.instructions: Partition each number line into the given number of equal parts.

bigIdea.title: Partition Number Lines into Equal Lengths
bigIdea.subtitle: Same number of spaces as the denominator
bigIdea.intro: To put fractions on a number line, split the distance from 0 to 1 into equal parts. The number of parts matches the denominator.
bigIdea.bigQuestion: Why do the number of equal spaces match the denominator?

ruleCards.description: Split 0 to 1 into the denominator number of equal parts.

ruleCards.equation: each part is the same size
ruleCards.description: Each part must be the same length for fractions.

lessons.lesson_title: Locate Unit Fractions on Number Lines
lessons.fact_drill: Warm up by pointing to the first tick mark after 0 for different partitions.
lessons.concept: A unit fraction is one of the equal parts. On a number line, 1/4 is the first tick mark after 0 when 0 to 1 is split into 4 equal parts.
lessons.practice: Locate unit fractions like 1/2, 1/3, 1/4, and 1/6 on number lines.
lessons.objective: Locate unit fractions on number lines.

warmup.title: Luma Charge
warmup.instructions: Warm up with unit fractions on number lines.

questions.prompt: On a number line divided into 5 equal parts, what is the first tick mark after 0?
What unit fraction is halfway between 0 and 1?
On a number line divided into 8 equal parts, what is one part called?

learn.title: Locate Unit Fractions on Number Lines
teaching_points: Count one space from 0 for a unit fraction.
The denominator tells how many total spaces.
1/4 is at the first mark when there are 4 equal spaces.

example.prompt: Locate 1/3 on a number line from 0 to 1.
example.equation: 1/3 is one of three equal spaces from 0

try_it.title: Try one together
try_it.prompt: Locate 1/4 on a number line from 0 to 1.
try_it.hint: First tick mark after 0 when divided into 4.

practice_block.title: Practice Time
practice_block.instructions: Locate each unit fraction on a number line.

flashcards.title: Unit Fractions on Number Lines
flashcards.instructions: Review unit fractions on number lines.

bigIdea.title: Locate Unit Fractions on Number Lines
bigIdea.subtitle: One space from 0
bigIdea.intro: A unit fraction is one equal part of the whole. On a number line, it is the first tick mark after 0 when the whole is split into equal parts.
bigIdea.bigQuestion: How do you know where to place 1/4 on a number line?

lessons.fact_drill: Warm up by counting tick marks for fractions like 2/3, 3/4, and 4/6.
lessons.concept: Non-unit fractions are located by counting the number of equal spaces shown by the numerator from 0. 3/4 is three of four equal spaces from 0.
lessons.practice: Locate and graph non-unit fractions on number lines.
lessons.objective: Locate and graph non-unit fractions on number lines.

questions.prompt: On a number line divided into 5 equal parts, where is 3/5?
On a number line divided into 8 equal parts, where is 6/8?
Where is 2/3 on a number line?

learn.title: Locate and Graph Non-Unit Fractions
teaching_points: Partition 0 to 1 into the denominator number of parts.
Count the numerator number of spaces from 0.

example.prompt: Locate 3/6 on a number line from 0 to 1.
example.equation: 3/6 is three of six equal spaces from 0

try_it.title: Try one together
try_it.prompt: Locate 4/5 on a number line from 0 to 1.
try_it.hint: Split into 5 equal parts, count 4 spaces.

practice_block.title: Practice Time
practice_block.instructions: Locate and label each non-unit fraction on a number line.

flashcards.title: Non-Unit Fractions on Number Lines
flashcards.instructions: Review non-unit fractions on number lines.

bigIdea.title: Locate and Graph Non-Unit Fractions
bigIdea.subtitle: Count the numerator spaces from 0
bigIdea.intro: Non-unit fractions are found by counting the number of equal spaces shown by the numerator. 4/5 is four of five equal spaces from 0.
bigIdea.bigQuestion: How is locating 4/5 like taking 4 jumps of 1/5?

lessons.lesson_title: Unit Evaluation: Fractions on Number Lines
lessons.fact_drill: Rapid review of the 0 to 1 interval, partitioning number lines, locating unit fractions, and locating non-unit fractions.
lessons.concept: Review the four big ideas from this unit: the interval from 0 to 1, partitioning number lines into equal lengths, locating unit fractions, and locating non-unit fractions.
lessons.practice: Complete a balanced evaluation covering the skills from this unit.
lessons.objective: Show what you know about fractions on number lines.

warmup.title: Luma Charge
warmup.instructions: Get ready to show what you know.

questions.prompt: On a number line from 0 to 1 divided into 4 equal parts, where is 1/4?
On a number line divided into 6 equal parts, where is 5/6?
How many equal spaces are needed to show eighths?

learn.title: Ready to Show What You Know
teaching_points: Use any strategy that helps you.

example.prompt: You have learned four big ideas this unit.
example.equation: 0 to 1 + partitioning + unit fractions + non-unit fractions = fractions on number lines

try_it.title: Try one together
try_it.prompt: Where is 3/4 on a number line from 0 to 1?
try_it.hint: Split into 4 equal parts, count 3 spaces.

practice_block.title: Unit Evaluation
practice_block.instructions: Answer all questions carefully to show your understanding.

flashcards.title: Unit 28 Review
flashcards.instructions: Review key terms from Unit 28 before the evaluation.

bigIdea.title: Unit Evaluation: Fractions on Number Lines
bigIdea.subtitle: Show what you know
bigIdea.intro: This evaluation checks your understanding of the four big ideas from this unit: the interval from 0 to 1, partitioning number lines into equal lengths, locating unit fractions, and locating non-unit fractions.
bigIdea.bigQuestion: What do you know about fractions on number lines?

ruleCards.description: Fractions between 0 and 1 show parts of one whole.
The numerator tells how many spaces to count.
